 Parth Samthaan reveals Seher Hone Ko Hai is going off air soon: When and where to watch the last episode of the hit TV series?
 SECTIONS Parth Samthaan reveals Seher Hone Ko Hai is going off air soon: When and where to watch the last episode of the hit TV series? ET Online Last Updated: Nov 07, 2026, 09:03:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis In a viral Instagram video, Parth Samthaan, aka Mahid, revealed that Seher Hone Ko Hai was ending soon. He claimed that the TV series was not supposed to end so soon and Colours had wanted it to continue but did not state the reason it was going off air.
 Agencies Seher Hone Ko Hai ending on Nov 14 Bad news for Seher Hone Ko Hai fans. In an Instagram video, Parth Samthaan , aka Mahid, revealed that the show was indeed going off air very soon. In the video that has gone viral on Instagram, the actor looked very emotional and revealed that the rumours of the TV series ending were true, and it would come to an end on November 14. He also revealed that it was his last day on set.
 The actor also claimed that the TV show was not supposed to go off air so soon and that the decision to end the TV show did not come from Colours. However, he also assured his fans he would return to shooting in another project this month.
Despite the setback, Parth expressed enthusiasm about celebrating Diwali with his family. The actor also revealed that he had been dealing with persistent sleep-related difficulties for some time. Before committing to his next professional project, he plans to take a break to prioritise his well-being, focus on his health and give himself adequate time to recover. 
 Where Can You Watch Final Episode?
The final episode of Sehere Hone Ko Hai can be streamed on JioHotstar digitally or seen on Colours TV.
 About Seher Hone Ko Hai
An unofficial adaptation of the hit Turkish TV series Kizil Goncalar . The TV series revolves around the life of Seher Baig, who dreams of being a doctor. However, her dreams come crashing down when her orthodox father arranges her marriage to Mahid, the grandson of Lucknow’s mufti. The series explores her eventually realising her dreams and becoming a successful neurology resident. She also temporarily becomes estranged from her husband, whom she blames for her mother Kauser’s death. In a twist of fate, Mahid ends up as Seher’s patient.
The role of Seher has also undergone a change of faces. Earlier, Rishita Kothari essayed the role of Seher. After a seven-year time leap, Bhavika Sharma took over the reins.
